evals.prompt: Produce the detailed design for the approved architecture, including interface invariants, data lifecycle, failure paths, trust boundaries, and concurrency.
evals.expected_output: A construction-ready detailed design traceable to approved inputs and explicit about unresolved decisions.
assertions: Interfaces include behavioral contracts beyond type signatures
Critical flows include timeout and partial-failure paths
Security and concurrency assumptions are explicit

evals.prompt: No architecture document exists, but the approved requirements leave no material platform choice open. Decide whether detailed design can proceed and state the basis.
evals.expected_output: A scoped design that proceeds only if approved inputs are sufficient, otherwise identifies the exact blocking decision.
assertions: Missing documents are not treated as an automatic blocker
Any blocker names the required decision or evidence
